reviews.t: These are the BEST! The quality is incredible and the price is ...
reviews.x: These are the BEST! The quality is incredible and the price is fantastic! I will definitely be ordering more and sending these to clients! I wish you had more that said: Thank You, Happy Birthday, Congratulations, Get Well, Happy Anniversary, etc. I would buy all of them!

I ordered notecards for a close friend’s son heading off to the Air Force. I was not expecting the beautiful quality that arrived. The notecards have a luxurious weight to them and came in a lovely box that will be handy for storage. I’ll be sure to look at the other cards you carry. Thank you!

reviews.t: Who needs custom printing...these are fantastic!
reviews.x: These cards can be used for an abundance of reasons and they have a real nice texture to them and weight.  They are not flimsy or cheap looking/feeling and the value you get for the price is unbeatable!  Just as good as custom printing...but without the price!

They are perfect! I ordered them yesterday. They were delivered today. I love the box that they come in and the cards are very sturdy. Thank you so much!! I am a Realtor and need to send follow-up cards to my clients. I will definitely order them again!

Ordered these for a project. Showed up on time. Great, sturdy cards.  UPDATE: had to take off star because 100 cards, 99 envelopes.  Grrrr! And the envelopes were sealed in some parts, so I had to pry it apart with a butter knife. I was using all 100 of these at one time,  so not having the correct amount of envelopes is annoying, to day the least.

How fun!! I love these! So great to use as little notes to friends and family. The quality of the paper is excellent, they are a fun thick texture. I love the box they come in. Good purchase.  This is an edit to the previous review because I had to: Just used this and hadn't realized they were self sealing. Amazing! Love them even more!

reviews.t: Amazing Quality & Quantity For The Price
reviews.x: These notes are perfect and a big hit with my clients.  Great Quality and a great price.  I use these a lot for business and I used to cruise the aisles of Marshall's and home goods looking for these cards and even on sale you almost can't beat the price of these cards for the quantity.  You can even repurpose the box.

reviews.t: Very Nice...they look like custom cards
reviews.x: I love these cards. They are heavy card stock with raised lettering. This is the second box of Hello I ordered in a few months. I also love their "Thank You" cards...very classy.  I am a big card writer and I am always searching for something different. They have an updated look to them. I will purchase again.

I'm so thankful for the adhesive envelopes. Makes it a lot easier when you are writing many cards. The quality is excellent. The "hello" writing is recessed in the printing is perfect the contrast is excellent.
This was such a great purchase for the price - they look and feel high quality and are perfect note cards! And the self sticking envelopes is such a quality added feature
These cards are perfect.  Beautiful paper that is quality that you wouldn’t ever see for the price.  I will be buying from this brand again.

reviews.t: FABULOUS Note Cards!!! Quality Paper, Bold ...
reviews.x: FABULOUS Note Cards!!!  Quality Paper, Bold (neat) Print throughout entire box. I cannot wait for more options to choose from!!!
Great weight, and very happy with the product. Better than I expected
Love the cards. I will definitely order more. Thank you 😊
Outstanding quality. Couldn't be happier.
Outstanding quality. Couldn't be happier.

reviews.t: Stop searching for the perfect cards, these are it!
reviews.x: I have purchased multiple "hello" cards for my job (marketing) and these were my last purchase. The quality is like no other. The packaging makes my life so much easier because the box is solid and I can keep then stored in it. I was. It expecting the amazing quality when I buught them due to the price. I was way wrong. The boss and I were amazed by the quality and beauty of these cards. They are perfect for a hand written hello!! Thank you:)

I own a real estate company and we ordered these to send out hand written notes on to our clients and perspective clients. We love the quickness in which we received them the box they come in is very strong and each agent carries the project addresses and pens in the box with the notecards until they complete all 100 then return to me to mail.  We’ve ordered again and again and will continue to do so!

There cards are not for the faint of heart. I wasn't expecting the quality cardstock or the thick envelopes. These by far exceeded my expectations. When I finish this box, I will buy more. BTW, the sturdy box in which these come is a great bonus item! The card cardstock is textured, so if you're after a smooth look, this is not the ones for you.

These cards are exactly what I have been searching for to use in my business. They look modern and fun with the font chosen, and I LOVE that the envelopes are self seal!! I am thinking if I ever want to add a pop of color, I may add some washi tape on the front or inside. I will look to purchase these again!

Fabulous product! The stock is heavy and very rich looking. The simple message, "hello" makes it suitable for every occasion and purpose. I was a little nervous at first, ordering 100, but now I'm wondering if that will be enough. This was a really smart purchase and I would recommend it highly.

I purchased both the black "Hello" and gold "Thank you" versions. Beautiful cards, incredibly quality + absolutely amazing price for such great quality cards.  I own a small business and these add a perfect touch to send out with my orders. Thank you for making such an affordable and beautiful product!

These are absolutely perfect!  They look like something twice the price!  I was so in love with them, then I went to lick the envelope and remembered they are self-sealing and fell in love all over again!  I will definitely order more as needed!

reviews.t: A nice simple HELLO message that is so versatile for all ...
reviews.x: Exceeded my expectations!  These are high quality letterpress notecard on heavy stock paper.  A nice simple HELLO message that is so versatile for all occasions.  100 cards + 100 envelopes for $25 -  an unbeatable value!

GREAT price for GREAT cards. I LOVE them. It's actually card stock so the cards feel sturdy, AND the letterpressed HELLO looks so clean. I use these for business purposes and sending them out is a delight.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the high quality, sturdy, and heavy card stock.
Many customers say the cards offer excellent value for the price.
Several reviewers appreciate the self-adhesive envelopes as a convenient feature.
Some customers mention the nice box the cards come in for storage.
One reviewer reports a negative experience with missing and sealed envelopes.
